paragraphs: R' Yonatan Sar HaBirah, “officer of the Birah.” See the entry R' Yonatan Ish HaBirah, “man of the Birah.”[^1]

notes.text: Sar HaBirah and Ish HaBirah preserve the distinct “officer” and “man” designations. Birah is retained without deciding between a citadel or another specific location; it is not identified as a capital. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
